articles.title: Asteroid (14331) Alyankovic: Weird Al Yankovic Gets a Space Rock Named After Him
articles.summary: The International Astronomical Union named asteroid (14331) Alyankovic after musician Weird Al Yankovic. The 1-to-1.25-mile-wide rock orbits between Mars and Jupiter.

articles.title: Armadillo-Inspired Robot Curls Into a Ball to Protect Fragile Cargo
articles.summary: Engineers created a soft robot that rolls up like a three-banded armadillo. When touched, it curls into a wheel in about a minute to shield electronics inside.

articles.title: Astronomers Spot a Shock Wave Around a Dead Star That Shouldn't Be There
articles.summary: A dead star called RXJ0528+2838 is producing a powerful shock wave, but it has no disc to explain it. The discovery challenges current ideas about stellar remnants.
